reviews.title: Works great and fits perfectly
reviews.comment: Very useful set of adapter wires when trying to reduce the amount of wires in my system. I completely ditched the Corsair lighting pro module and the two lighting nodes for a single Nollie RGB controller (controlled with the OpenRGB software). The Nollie uses standard 3 pin setup for 5v rgb lights but the Corsair family of RGB products do not. These wires helped connect the Corsair RGB fans to the Nollie and it all works perfectly fine.
reviews.author: Bruce Meyer

reviews.title: MSI RGB board to Corsair RGB fans
reviews.comment: This is exactly what I needed to go from my MSI case rgb board to my Corsair RGB fans. The odd little extra bit at the end shown detached was connected to the cord and threw me off at first.
